values.note: 7 sites, 2 of them walk-in (park at a distance). Trailer/RV spurs average 12 x 32 ft, and the access road is 'not suitable for vehicles longer than 32''.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chippy-park-campground ('Camp sites: 7', '2 Sites are walk-in (park at a distance)', 'Access road not suitable for vehicles longer than 32'', 'Trailer/RV Sites Average Parking Spur: 12' x32''), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water Memorial Day through Labor Day only. No trash pickup and no firewood; accessible toilets, tables, fire rings and parking.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chippy-park-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; Water 'Potable water is available at this site. Memorial Day thru Labor Day.'; 'Trash Pickup: No', 'Firewood: No'; Accessibility 'Toilets, Tables, Fire Rings, Parking'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open year round depending on weather conditions (access is limited during the fall and winter due to snow)'.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chippy-park-campground (General Information 'Open year round depending on weather conditions. (access is limited during the fall and winter due to snow)'; Seasons of Use 'All Year.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $5 a night for each additional vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/chippy-park-campground ('Single Site: $12 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per night'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin National Forest (Yellowstone RD) small roadside campground on the Main Boulder River with easy river access, ~25 mi south of Big Timber on US-298 then ~9.5 mi on Main Boulder Rd (County Rd 212). --Claude
summary: Forest Service page confirms 7 sites (2 walk-in), 32-ft road/spur limit, vault toilets, potable water (Memorial Day - Labor Day), FCFS, $12/night (+$5 vehicle). Added season year-round (weather dependent, limited access in fall/winter) and facility notes (no trash, no firewood). Note trimmed of the restated fields.
